title: D-Wave: Model Value vs. Price

beats.text: D-Wave (QBTS) trades at $20.09 a share. What does a fundamental-value model say?
The model's fair-value estimate is just $2.63, as of July 11 — a wide gap.
Quantum computing is making real progress, but that price bakes in a lot of hope.
